message: Please table the budget item at Friday's meeting.
meaning: Put the budget item on Friday's agenda and discuss it then.

message: Please send the signed form by 03/04.
Bring a plate to the team lunch on Friday.
meaning: Bring a dish of food to share.

message: The meeting has been moved forward by two days.
meaning: The meeting is now two days earlier than planned.

message: Our biweekly sync starts next week.
meaning: The sync happens once every two weeks.
Please reply to this message by Monday.

message: Quite good work on the report; a few tweaks needed before it goes out.
meaning: The report is acceptable but needs some changes before it is sent.

message: Timesheets are due by end of play on Friday.
meaning: Submit timesheets by 5 pm on Friday.

message: Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date.
meaning: Pay no later than 30 calendar days after the date on the invoice.

message: Summarise the ticket and close it if it's resolved.
meaning: Write a summary; close the ticket only after the customer confirms the fix.

message: Delete old files from the shared drive.
meaning: Delete files in the shared drive that nobody has changed for more than 12 months; keep everything else.

message: Reply to customers quickly and keep it short.
meaning: Answer each customer within one hour, in at most three sentences.

message: Escalate anything urgent to the on-call engineer.
meaning: Page the on-call engineer only when a service is down or customer data is at risk; log everything else.

message: Don't email the client until legal has signed off, then send the update.
meaning: Wait for written approval from the legal team, then email the client the update once.
